verdict.rationale: Mastra is a workflow and agent framework with a server and cloud deployment, so priority-aware, tenant-fair run scheduling is a fair question for it. However, the evidence never mentions run priorities, per-tenant fairness, or any queueing behavior. The retries, branches, recurring schedules and event-triggered workflow runs it documents are adjacent features and do not deliver priority or fair scheduling.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I assign priorities to runs and get fair scheduling across tenants instead of a single FIFO queue
